abstract.p: To enforce the privilege separation in the kernel, kernel-level isolated execution environment (IEE) has become a recent research trend because it can protect critical resources and monitors. Our research found that to isolate the IEE memory, all existing IEEs must act as a reference monitor to isolate page tables and validate their updates, bringing a significant performance overhead.
